asides.label: What is a stage?
asides.blurb: Untimed: on offer all the time, even at rest.

body.text: A stage is the picture area of the figure. The chips sit in its top corner and never move it.

items: Chips are buttons you can reach with the keyboard.
Close, or Escape, brings you back.

body.text: A long body scrolls inside the panel, so the panel never grows past the stage, even on a phone.
Filler to make the body long enough to need scrolling at a narrow width: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, again and again and again.
